raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers is an SCD2 history table with 230 rows for 200 customers: 200 rows are is_current=True and 30 are superseded historical rows. The unfiltered join in gold_region_daily matches each transaction for those 30 customers to two region rows, inflating the count from 4582 to 5279. Restricting the customer join to is_current=True gives one row per customer and reconciles to silver_transactions, and point-in-time validity does not change the result because all transactions fall after 2025-01-01.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"gold_region_daily": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold_region_daily AS SELECT t.txn_date, c.region, count(*) AS n_txn, sum(t.amount) AS total FROM silver_transactions t JOIN (SELECT customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers WHERE is_current) c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY t.txn_date, c.region;"}}
